items.title: Detention of top leadership
items.summary: Detention of top leadership (Sat Oct 10 morning, ahead of 10 AM IST protest): Delhi Police boarded Abhijeet Dipke's Mumbai→Delhi flight at IGI Airport and detained Dipke, Saurav Das, and Ashutosh Ranka on landing (reports ~10:15–10:30 AM IST; Dipke: 'I have come here to be arrested...'). Dhruv Rathee detained this morning (sources differ: from Gurugram residence / at protest site). Ratna Singh (CJP legal-cell head) also detained.

items.title: Delhi Police on X REFUTED Dipke's family's 'Delhi Police is lying' claim
items.summary: Delhi Police on X REFUTED Dipke's family's 'Delhi Police is lying' claim (IANS via hiindia.com, Oct 11): said the news of Abhijeet Dipke's grandmother's demise was conveyed to him in detention 'with due sensitivity,' that he was informed of the scheduled funeral time and 'offered all possible assistance' to travel home on humanitarian grounds — 'however he denied to avail the same.' New detail ('denied to avail') vs the earlier-logged Oct 10 humanitarian-travel offer; directly answers parents Bhagwan/Anita Dipke's claim they could not contact him and had put the last rites on hold.

items.title: Criminal case — Mumbai Police filed an FIR against actor Imran Khan and others
items.summary: criminal case — Mumbai Police filed an FIR against actor Imran Khan and others over Saturday's Mumbai protest at August Kranti Maidan; Khan had been detained and released a couple of hours later. Blog lists the FIR under sections 223, 126(2), 189(2), 189(3) and 189(5), described as of the Indian Penal Code. First criminal case against a named celebrity participant of the protest (02:35 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog).

items.title: Delhi Police FIR count firmed up — 20 FIRs registered in connection with
items.summary: Delhi Police FIR count firmed up — 20 FIRs registered in connection with Saturday's CJP protest (PTI via thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 03:55 PM IST / 10:25Z), 'against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.' Corroborates/fixes the count vs the earlier IANS 'over 20 FIRs' note.

items.title: AAP streamed a press conference on X on what it called the government's 'brutal
items.summary: AAP streamed a press conference on X on what it called the government's 'brutal oppression of democratic rights' (~04:03 PM IST). First post-Saturday-crackdown opposition-party presser from AAP (substance not yet captured).

items.title: Injury report confirmed in detail — two Delhi Police personnel, including a
items.summary: Injury report confirmed in detail — two Delhi Police personnel, including a Pink Force woman officer, injured Saturday amid the detention of ~1,000 protesters across New Delhi district; the injured officers (Suman and Dheeraj Yadav) taken to a nearby hospital, circumstances being examined (04:38 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog). Confirms/refines the earlier stone-pelting report near the PTI building. Separately, Delhi Police released a video explaining its denial of permission for the CJP protest (05:02 PM IST).

items.title: TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee claimed ~2,500 people detained across Delhi on
items.summary: TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee claimed ~2,500 people detained across Delhi on Saturday — including party activists, supporters, and even bystanders — saying Mamata Banerjee and five TMC MPs were picked up while 'sitting at a bus stop, staging a peaceful protest' against vote theft; also claimed metro stations, railway stations and airports remain shut 'even after the Supreme Court's directives,' and that a ten-member INDIA delegation met the President yesterday with a memorandum (05:23 PM IST; ANI via thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: DMRC EXTENDED the closure of 45 metro stations until 10 PM Saturday amid the
items.summary: DMRC EXTENDED the closure of 45 metro stations until 10 PM Saturday (was till 6 PM) amid the ongoing protest (06:28 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: Mamata Banerjee RELEASED after her Saturday-afternoon detention by Delhi Police
items.summary: Mamata Banerjee RELEASED after her Saturday-afternoon detention by Delhi Police (08:22 PM IST; ANI via thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: CJP official statement
items.summary: CJP official statement (10:40 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog): nationwide protests will continue until CEC Gyanesh Kumar resigns — formal reaffirmation of the demand after Saturday's crackdown (no new facts beyond restatement, supporting the logged Sunday-march plan).

items.title: India officially rejected the UN Human Rights office's concerns over the mass
items.summary: India officially rejected the UN Human Rights office's concerns over the mass detentions during Saturday's CJP protest, calling the remarks 'misplaced' (11:23 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog). First government response to the UN statement (@UNHumanRights had called on authorities to ensure the right to peaceful assembly is respected).

items.title: All train services suspended as part of Saturday's security arrangements will
items.summary: All train services suspended as part of Saturday's security arrangements will resume their normal schedules from October 11, officials said (11:23 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog). Ends the 4 AM–2 PM Saturday cancellations of Mail/Express trains to New Delhi/Hazrat Nizamuddin. Comes alongside the DMRC reopening of all 45 metro stations.

items.title: Tally claim — AAP leader Sanjay Singh said in a PTI video that 'more than 6,000
items.summary: tally claim — AAP leader Sanjay Singh said in a PTI video that 'more than 6,000 people were arrested in Delhi yesterday' (Saturday). Claim; prior reported ranges: ~1,500 (HT citing Delhi Police), 2,000+ (Reuters), 3,000+ (Tribune/ETV/TOI).

items.title: FIRST ruling-party-president-level statement of the protest: BJP national
items.summary: FIRST ruling-party-president-level statement of the protest: BJP national president Nitin Nabin 'lambasted the CJP' on X on Saturday, saying 'You cannot bear to see India moving forward as a self-reliant and empowered nation, and you are attempting to destabilize it at the behest of foreign forces' (CNN). Escalates beyond the logged Sambit Patra press-conference party line and Delhi CM Rekha Gupta statements to the party's national presidency, introducing a 'foreign forces' charge.

items.title: Delhi Sikh Gurdwara Management Committee President responded to the Saturday
items.summary: Delhi Sikh Gurdwara Management Committee (DSGMC) President responded to the Saturday Bangla Sahib episode — accused AAP MLAs in Delhi of 'playing dirty politics' and manipulating the situation, said it was 'deeply distressing' to see the gurdwara turned into a political arena and that police in uniform traversing the shrine grounds is 'absolutely intolerable,' while also saying protesters intruding and staging a demonstration inside 'deeply hurt Sikh sentiments.' First institutional Sikh-community statement on the gurdwara detentions (police detained 60+ protesters who sheltered there; AISA's Neha Bora had slammed police for entering the shrine).

items.title: A Delhi court DISMISSED an application moved on behalf of CJP legal head Ratna
items.summary: a Delhi court DISMISSED an application moved on behalf of CJP legal head Ratna Singh seeking registration of an FIR or NCR against police over her Oct 10 detention — CJM Abhinav Pandey held it not maintainable (no supporting affidavit, no named public servant; couldn't decipher the 'Officer Superior' for a Section 175(4) BNSS status report). Court also rejected the NCR alternative prayer as self-contradictory (alleged offences are cognisable under BNS). Her separate immediate-release application also dismissed.

items.title: Escalation framing : at a Saturday-evening press conference, Ajinkya Shinde
items.summary: Escalation framing (single-sourced, illustrateddailynews.com): at a Saturday-evening press conference, Ajinkya Shinde vowed CJP supporters would march to Jantar Mantar EVERY DAY (not just Sunday Oct 11) until CEC Gyanesh Kumar resigns; SFI general secretary Srijan Bhattacharyya said student protests would spread nationwide from Sunday. Not yet corroborated by major outlets.

items.title: After Delhi Police informed detained founder Abhijeet Dipke of his
items.summary: After Delhi Police informed detained founder Abhijeet Dipke of his grandmother's demise, police told him it was his choice whether to stay back and continue the protest under detention or fly back for the last rites. Grandmother Savitribai Shankarrao Dipke, 85, died at 11:30 AM Saturday at the paternal house in Santuk Pimpri village (Hingoli district) after a prolonged illness; last rites at 10 AM Sunday. His cousin said the family had contacted his parents, who are on their way to Santuk Pimpri.

items.title: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke's paternal grandmother Savitribai Dipke, 85, died
items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke's paternal grandmother Savitribai (Shankar) Dipke, 85, died Saturday morning at the family village of Santuk Pimpri, Hingoli district, Maharashtra (unwell for past few days), hours after Dipke was detained by Delhi Police at IGI Airport (reported by ETV Bharat, Livemint; Top Indian News citing CJP's X backup @Cockroachisback). Unclear whether Dipke has been informed in custody; sources say police likely to arrange travel to Sambhajinagar once he receives the news. No confirmed information on his release or funeral attendance yet.

items.title: CPI leaders detained on arrival at Jantar Mantar (per CPI , reported Mint Oct
items.summary: CPI(M) leaders detained on arrival at Jantar Mantar (per CPI(M), reported Mint Oct 10): Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan, MA Baby, Brinda Karat, KK Shailaja, John Brittas MP, MV Govindan Master, A Vijayaraghavan, KN Balagopal, PK Sreemathi. Tushar Gandhi (Mahatma Gandhi's great-grandson) detained in Mumbai; Manish Sisodia (AAP) detained in Chandigarh. Reports say 1,500+ detained across Delhi (up from 150+ at Jantar Mantar); Mint cites ~35,000 police/paramilitary deployed.

items.title: Supreme Court urgent hearing on Delhi lockdown ahead of Oct 10 Jantar Mantar
items.summary: Supreme Court urgent hearing (CJI Surya Kant bench, Oct 9) on Delhi lockdown ahead of Oct 10 Jantar Mantar protest: directed NO complete prohibition of metro/train movement — regulated manner, proportionality; Solicitor General agreed to reconsider and impress upon authorities; ordered publicity of revised security plan. Said 'one should not use a hammer to kill a fly.'

items.title: Supreme Court Bar Association appealed to the Chief Justice of India over
items.summary: Supreme Court Bar Association appealed to the Chief Justice of India over detention of lawyers during Saturday's CJP protest — senior and junior advocates, incl. women lawyers, who marched from the Supreme Court toward Jantar Mantar and were stopped/detained at barricades on Bhagwan Das Road. SCBA sought establishment of detained advocates' whereabouts/safety, access to legal assistance, release where no lawful grounds exist, and a probe into alleged excessive force by Delhi Police/central security forces.

items.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee REMAINS in detention after his Saturday-morning Gurugram
items.summary: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee REMAINS in detention after his Saturday-morning Gurugram pickup, police confirmed (12:15 AM IST, Oct 11; thedailyjagran.com live blog) — he was NOT part of the late-night mass release from the temporary detention centres. CJP leaders Dipke, Das, Ranka also still in custody; still no word on Dipke's release or his grandmother's 10 AM Sunday last rites.

items.title: Amnesty International joined the UN Human Rights Office in condemning the
items.summary: Amnesty International joined the UN Human Rights Office in condemning the crackdown, after reports of mass arrests and restrictions on peaceful protests (thedailyjagran.com summary, updated 12:16 AM IST Oct 11). Widens the international-reaction front beyond the previously logged UN statement.

items.title: A habeas corpus petition was filed in the Supreme Court by Gaurav Bharti
items.summary: a habeas corpus petition (Article 32, Diary No. 63926/2026) was filed in the Supreme Court by Gaurav Bharti (CJP Coverage Coordinator) through Advocates Rajesh G. Inamdar and Shashwat Anand, seeking production and release of Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka and other detained persons; urgent listing was sought alongside Diary No.

items.title: RELEASE — YouTuber Dhruv Rathee released around 3 AM IST Sunday Oct 11 after
items.summary: RELEASE — YouTuber Dhruv Rathee released around 3 AM IST Sunday Oct 11 after his Saturday-morning Gurugram pickup, per Delhi Police sources (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 09:12 AM IST). Police warned action would be taken again if he attempts to reach Jantar Mantar for Sunday's protest. (Blog entries timestamped 03:38–03:49Z, missed by the 04:00Z run; surfacing now.)

items.title: Fresh official CJP statement
items.summary: Fresh official CJP statement (@cockroachjantaparty IG, 10:25 PM PDT / 5:25 AM IST Oct 11): 'It's been 12 hours. No accountability.' Demands immediate release of Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, immediate disclosure of their whereabouts, and immediate access to their lawyers — 'You cannot make people disappear and call it democracy.' First official CJP post since Delhi Police's humanitarian-travel offer and the mass release of other detainees; ~20K likes within minutes. Still no word on Dipke contacting family or attending grandmother's last rites (10 AM Sunday IST).

items.title: Court-production details locked in — CJP's legal head Ratna Singh posted on X
items.summary: Court-production details locked in — CJP's legal head Ratna Singh (now free and acting as counsel) posted on X that Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das will be produced before the EXECUTIVE MAGISTRATE at Delhi Cantt Police Station at 9 AM Sunday Oct 11; she said she will be present with other advocates (IANS via hiindia.com; Jagran day-2 live blog 08:47 AM IST). Refines the earlier logged 'CMM Court' note — the venue is now confirmed as the Executive Magistrate at Delhi Cantt PS. Delhi Police confirmed the preventive arrest; Bar and Bench reports the activists were held under BNSS Sections 126 (security for keeping peace) / 170 (arrest to prevent cognisable offences) — first stated legal basis for the detentions.

items.title: Nighttime Connaught Place protest footage — young women physically detained
items.summary: (The Lallantop IG reel @thelallantop, posted 03:20:44Z / 8:50 AM IST Mon, covering Sunday-night Oct 11): nighttime Connaught Place protest footage — young women physically detained, pulled to the ground; witnesses allege brutal detention, fear inside police vehicles, police targeting women, phones taken, held for hours near Naresh PS. First visual/reporting detail on the logged 'fresh evening CP action / ~200 detained' Sunday-night episode; adds women-targeting allegation.

items.title: STATUS CHANGE — Ratna Singh active again: CJP's legal affairs head, detained
items.summary: STATUS CHANGE — Ratna Singh active again: CJP's legal affairs head, detained Saturday morning, is now publicly posting on X as the party's lawyer and will represent Dipke/Das/Ranka at the 9 AM Sunday magistrate production (per IANS/hiindia.com citing her X post). No standalone release report; she is no longer counted among detainees. Also: four journalists' organisations (Press Club of India, Indian Women's Press Corps and two others) condemned the detention and alleged harassment of journalists covering Saturday's protest — several detained despite press ID cards, phones/equipment seized (joint statement Saturday; Jagran day-2 live blog 08:59 AM IST Oct 11).

items.title: Security heightened outside Delhi Cantt Police Station ahead of
items.summary: Security heightened outside Delhi Cantt Police Station ahead of Dipke/Ranka/Das's 9 AM IST production before the Executive Magistrate (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 09:19 AM IST Oct 11); Ratna Singh will be present as counsel. Outcome of production not yet reported.

items.title: Ajinkya Shinde called for a MUMBAI protest at T Junction, Shivaji Park, 4 PM
items.summary: Ajinkya Shinde called for a MUMBAI protest at T Junction, Shivaji Park, 4 PM Sunday Oct 11 — 'Across the country protests have started against the dictatorship... More cities will follow soon' (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 09:08 AM IST Oct 11). New-city protest call beyond Delhi's 10 AM Jantar Mantar march.

items.title: Dipke's parents publicly dispute police's version — father Bhagwan Dipke: 'We
items.summary: Dipke's parents publicly dispute police's version — father Bhagwan Dipke: 'We tried contacting him but could not succeed. If he had received news of his grandmother's demise, he would have come by now. His friends told me that he has been shifted somewhere else; he is not in Delhi.' Mother Anita Dipke: 'We have not been able to contact him...

items.title: AISA president Neha Bora posted on X calling for Sunday's agitation to
items.summary: AISA president Neha Bora posted on X calling for Sunday's agitation to continue: 'Let a hundred Jantar Mantars bloom! Another part of Delhi will become Jantar Mantar tomorrow.' (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 09:49 AM IST)

items.title: Official CJP post claims 'They detained CJP's team from Connaught Place!'
items.summary: official CJP post claims 'They detained CJP's team from Connaught Place!' — alleges a detention of CJP's team at CP in the early hours of Sunday, ahead of the 10 AM IST Jantar Mantar march. Single-sourced from CJP itself (caption-only claim, no names/counts), not independently corroborated; pre-dates the logged 12:44 PM IST CP demonstration report, so it likely describes pre-march police action at CP. Surfaces in the same IG-CLI leg that also confirmed @abhijeetdipke has no new posts (newest still 22:53:53Z Oct 10, 'Coward.').

items.title: FIRST confirmation of Dipke's post-release travel plans
items.summary: FIRST confirmation of Dipke's post-release travel plans (CNN article 'India's Cockroach movement founder and leaders released', updated <1h before run / ~07:30Z): after release, Abhijeet Dipke criticized PM Modi, said he was 'returning home to be with family' during 'this moment of grief,' and wrote on X: 'The CJP will neither back down nor be intimidated.' Partially resolves the open 'last-rites travel' question (rites were due 10 AM IST; family had put them on hold) — travel confirmed but not arrival timing. CNN also reports ground detail: only a handful of protesters at Jantar Mantar Sunday with slogan-shouters promptly detained, and cites an anonymous official saying 'more than 2,000 protesters were detained' (already covered by CNN small-turnout log).

items.title: FIRST turnout/outcome reporting on the Sunday 10 AM IST Jantar Mantar march
items.summary: FIRST turnout/outcome reporting on the Sunday 10 AM IST Jantar Mantar march (now ~2.5h in): CNN (updated <1h before this run) reports numbers turning out were small, with central Delhi sealed and heavy police presence continuing on Sunday. Fills the 'no credible turnout reporting' gap flagged by the 06:45Z run. NDTV's single-sourced 'remove all barricades' SC claim (06:37:35Z) still uncorroborated; CNN's 'central Delhi sealed' framing runs against barricade removal.

items.title: Detention tally — thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog intro
items.summary: detention tally — thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog intro (updated 12:20 PM IST): 'Around 400 suspected protesters were detained from different parts of Delhi overnight by the cops' — new post-midnight Sunday detention tally not in any earlier tally (7,000+ Saturday detentions were already mass-released except CJP leaders). Single-sourced from the blog intro; unclear if distinct from Saturday-night counts, watch for corroboration. Blog has no entries newer than the logged 12:27 PM IST SC contempt-notice item.

items.title: Court action at the Sunday special sitting
items.summary: Court action at the Sunday special sitting (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 12:27 PM IST / 06:57Z entry, missed by all earlier runs): the Supreme Court ISSUED NOTICE TO THE CENTRE on the plea seeking initiation of contempt proceedings against authorities over alleged violation of the Oct 9 order on metro/train curbs ('Did Authorities Violate Court Orders?'). First formal court action in Sunday's Bagchi/Mohana special sitting — advances the earlier logged 'will hear all sides, ensure no public trouble' note; no order yet on either the contempt plea or the Guruswamy preventive-detention challenge.

items.title: Protest front — demonstrators staging a demonstration at Connaught Place on
items.summary: protest front — demonstrators staging a demonstration at Connaught Place on Sunday demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation (12:44 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 'Demonstrations March At CP Demanding CEC's Resignation'). First CP protest report of the day beyond Jantar Mantar; comes with central Delhi sealed and heavy police presence per CNN's small-turnout Sunday-march report.

items.title: Arrests — Delhi Police arrested 4 men claiming to be members of the right-wing
items.summary: arrests — Delhi Police arrested 4 men claiming to be members of the right-wing Hindu Raksha Dal for allegedly assaulting students and pushing and hitting women on Delhi's DDU Marg during the CJP's October 10 protest (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 12:48 PM IST / 07:18Z entry; police said, Sunday). First arrest-action tied to a reported attack on protesters/students during Saturday's crackdown — advances the Saturday 'two injured police personnel' violence picture and introduces a counter-protest/assault angle. (Blog full-page open this run; entry is the newest on the blog, landing after the prior run's 07:26Z full-page check.)

items.title: CP detention scope clarified — day-2 live blog intro now states CJP workers
items.summary: CP detention scope clarified — day-2 live blog intro now states CJP workers were also detained at Connaught Place on Sunday, beyond the logged 01:28 PM IST entry's SFI/AISF/AIYF workers + John Brittas altercation. Resolves the headline/body 'CJP workers at CP' mismatch flagged at 08:50Z.

items.title: Connaught Place police action: Delhi Police detained workers of left-wing
items.summary: Connaught Place police action: Delhi Police detained workers of left-wing student organisations (SFI, AISF, AIYF) as they tried to hold a demonstration in CP's inner circle; police also TRIED to detain CPI(M) MP John Brittas, sparking an altercation (01:28 PM IST / 07:58Z; thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog — landed after the prior run's 08:10Z full-page check, never logged). Fresh detention/altercation angle in Sunday's CP protest front.

items.title: Supreme Court ORDER on the protest curbs
items.summary: Supreme Court ORDER on the protest curbs (Sunday special sitting): day-2 blog headline reads 'SC Directs Govt To Lift All Restrictions'; Senior Advocate / Rajya Sabha MP Kapil Sibal met Dipke, Ranka and Das after the SC hearing on restrictions and detention of protesters, thanking the court for 'passing an order that restores the faith of the Indian people... in the justice system of this country' (01:47 PM IST / 08:17Z; thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog). Advances the earlier logged 'notice to Centre on contempt plea' and corroborates the previously single-sourced NDTV 'remove all barricades' claim; exact order text not yet detailed.

items.title: CJP posted on X that five more of its leaders — Ankit Bharadwaj, Anam, Mukesh
items.summary: CJP posted on X that five more of its leaders — Ankit Bharadwaj, Anam, Mukesh, Balakrishna and Sudhir Sangwan — were detained Sunday while protesting peacefully; earlier Bharadwaj had posted they were held at Gate No. 3 near Bangla Sahib (~01:55 PM IST). Sudhir Sangwan already logged via IG reel; the other four names are new.

items.title: 2 PM IST presser content: Ashutosh Ranka says 'protest still ongoing'
items.summary: 2 PM IST presser content: Ashutosh Ranka says 'protest still ongoing' (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 03:35 PM IST / 10:05Z): speaking at the Press Club press conference, Ranka thanked the four former CMs (Kejriwal, Mamata Banerjee, Manik Sarkar, Pinarayi Vijayan) for joining the students/youth, said 'the protests are still ongoing,' and alleged that 'even today, several colleagues from CJP have been detained and subjected to physical assault,' that 'the entire SFI team was detained today,' and that 'many members of AISF have also faced detention and assault over the past few days.' First physical-assault allegation tied to Sunday's detentions; follows Das's 'hit the streets' call at the same presser.

items.title: Release terms clarified
items.summary: Release terms clarified (previously single-sourced 'on bond / no disturbing peace for a year' item, now corroborated): the Executive Magistrate released Dipke, Das and Ranka on the condition that they 'can not breach peace' for one year, according to CJP legal head Ratna Singh — reported by journalist Kumkum Binwal's channel (citing Singh), matching the News18 graphic's claim of a one-year peace condition. The 'barred from going to Jantar Mantar' claim remains single-sourced and unconfirmed. Post-release 2 PM IST Sunday press conference still pending; Sunday 10 AM IST Jantar Mantar march underway (~11:20 AM IST) with no credible turnout/outcome reporting yet; Dipke's grandmother's last-rites travel still unconfirmed.

items.title: CJP National Spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka announced the three released leaders
items.summary: CJP National Spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka announced the three released leaders — Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka — will address a press conference at 2 PM IST on Sunday. First formal scheduled media appearance since the ~10:10 AM IST Executive Magistrate release; chance to hear post-release statements and any release terms/conditions (still unreported).

items.title: FIRST outcome reporting on the 4 PM IST Mumbai Shivaji Park call — activist
items.summary: FIRST outcome reporting on the 4 PM IST Mumbai Shivaji Park call — activist Anjali Damania and several others were detained by police on arrival at Shivaji Park, Dadar, on Sunday while joining a pro-CJP protest (PTI; protestrecord.com sourced timeline 16:50 IST; Jagran day-2 blog 05:25 PM IST entry). First confirmation the Mumbai front drew police detentions.

items.title: NSUI workers detained by Delhi Police while holding a protest against CEC
items.summary: (catch-up; day-2 live blog NEWEST entry 04:22 PM IST / 10:52Z, landed just before baseline, never logged): NSUI workers detained by Delhi Police while holding a protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar. First NSUI (Congress student wing) detention report of day 2 — extends the Sunday detention scope beyond the logged SFI/AISF/AIYF/John Brittas Connaught Place detentions. (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog)

items.title: Video shows Delhi Police FORCIBLY DETAINING CJP National Spokesperson Sudhir
items.summary: (official @cockroachjantaparty IG reel, posted 04:32 PM IST / 11:02:47Z, ~12.5K likes within minutes): video shows Delhi Police FORCIBLY DETAINING CJP National Spokesperson Sudhir Sangwan and his team — officers grabbing seated protesters by limbs/clothing and dragging them across the road during a daytime sit-down protest; on-screen text: 'Delhi Police dragged CJP National Spokesperson Sudhir Sangwan and his team across the road!' and asks 'When will this brutality against peaceful protesters end?' First named spokesperson-level detention of Sunday; visually documents the force Ranka alleged at the 2 PM presser.

items.title: Escalation threat — Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk warned of a possible hunger
items.summary: Escalation threat — Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk warned of a possible hunger strike (anshan) or foot march (padyatra) if the detained CJP leaders/protesters are not released by Sunday (05:26 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog). Called the situation an 'undeclared emergency'; said he had appealed for unity and peace before the protest but had not anticipated the arrests.

items.title: CJP vows to intensify agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar; ~200 detained while
items.summary: CJP vows to intensify agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar; ~200 detained while protests were held at several places in the New Delhi area on Sunday evening (day-2 blog, 07:16 PM IST). First Sunday-evening detention figure.

items.title: Fresh evening Connaught Place action: Delhi Police detained protesters after a
items.summary: fresh evening Connaught Place action: Delhi Police detained protesters after a fresh anti-CEC protest at CP on Sunday evening (day-2 blog, 08:14 PM IST). Separate from the logged earlier-day CP detentions (SFI/AISF/AIYF/KYS, John Brittas).

items.title: Supreme Court to hold a special sitting on Sunday to hear a contempt plea
items.summary: Supreme Court to hold a special sitting on Sunday to hear a contempt plea against authorities for allegedly violating the Oct 9 order on public-transport restrictions (metro station closures, train curbs continuing despite SC directions) (08:52 PM IST; PTI via thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: Delhi Police said on X it offered detained founder Abhijeet Dipke assistance to
items.summary: Delhi Police said on X it offered detained founder Abhijeet Dipke assistance to travel home on 'humanitarian grounds' for his grandmother's last rites (10 AM Sunday). CJP replied: 'Where is Abhijeet? His family wants to talk to him; they're going to perform his grandmother's last rites tomorrow morning.

items.title: Delhi Traffic Police advisory for Sunday Oct 11: possible traffic diversions at
items.summary: Delhi Traffic Police advisory for Sunday Oct 11: possible traffic diversions at ~30 locations from 6 AM amid the law-and-order situation — Dhaula Kuan Flyover, Jhandewalan, Mandi House, Minto Road, Connaught Place, Jantar Mantar Road, Lodhi Road Flyover, Patel Chowk, Rail Bhawan, Gol Dak Khana, Windsor Palace, Jai Singh Road-Sansad Marg crossing (09:59 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog). Restrictions set up ahead of CJP's announced Sunday Jantar Mantar march and the INDIA bloc's Monday mega protest.

items.title: MASS RELEASE — Delhi Police released all detainees from the temporary detention
items.summary: MASS RELEASE — Delhi Police released all detainees from the temporary detention centres except the CJP leaders; 'due legal process would be followed' for the detained leaders (10:38 PM IST; ANI via thedailyjagran.com live blog). Dipke/Das/Ranka remain in custody; still no word on release or last-rites travel (last rites 10 AM Sunday).

items.title: Sunday march now CONFIRMED at 10 AM: CJP interim leader Ajinkya Shinde
items.summary: Sunday march now CONFIRMED at 10 AM: CJP interim leader Ajinkya Shinde announced at a post-crackdown press conference that the party will march to Jantar Mantar at 10 AM on Sunday Oct 11 until CEC Gyanesh Kumar resigns — 'The government must have thought we will return home after the detentions today. This fear of Modi, Shah shows we have won half the fight.' (TBS News, published 11:55 PM IST, updated 12:08 AM IST Oct 11). Confirms/times the previously logged Sunday-march plan.

items.title: Resolution of prior run's flagged caption-less video
items.summary: Resolution of prior run's flagged caption-less video (posted 18:39:16 PDT Oct 11 / 01:39:16Z, post_id 18092385257657221, 0 likes): no longer returned in @cockroachjantaparty's recent-posts page this run (account's newest post is still the 08:23:51 PDT Oct 11 women's-safety image) — appears deleted or de-ranked out of view. No facts were ever established from it; closing the flag with no reportable content.

items.title: SFI alleged mistreatment of detained women students
items.summary: SFI alleged mistreatment of detained women students. First such specific claim; exact incident/date unspecified. Single-sourced; watch for corroboration.

items.title: Protest front — OVER 3,000 STUDENTS rallied in KOLKATA demanding CEC Gyanesh
items.summary: protest front — OVER 3,000 STUDENTS rallied in KOLKATA demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged SIR irregularities. First Kolkata protest report of the protest; event timing within Oct 11 unspecified. Single-sourced; watch for corroboration.

items.title: Official @cockroachjantaparty image post
items.summary: official @cockroachjantaparty image post (455K likes): 'How can they even look women in the eye and talk about Women's Safety?' Rhetorical official-handle statement, lands amid the Sunday evening detention/assault-allegation reports; no new facts beyond the framing.

items.title: CPI Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas claims he was 'manhandled, dragged, assaulted
items.summary: CPI(M) Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas claims he was 'manhandled, dragged, assaulted and misbehaved' inside a police vehicle and dumped by the roadside 'for the crime of speaking to the media' after Sunday's CP detention; taken to RML Hospital for X-ray/medical exam (possible chest injuries); he has written to President Droupadi Murmu, the Rajya Sabha chairman and the CJI seeking urgent intervention, accountability for police personnel and parliamentary-privilege consideration (his X post). J&K CM Omar Abdullah condemned the 'unacceptable use of force'; CPI(M) general secretary M A Baby, after visiting Brittas at RML, alleged SFI President Adarsh M Saji, DYFI CEC member Jaick C Thomas and women protesters were assaulted inside police vehicles ('torture camps'/'mobile jails'); RJD MP Manoj Jha also visited Brittas.

items.title: Sunday special sitting specifics
items.summary: Sunday special sitting specifics (Bagchi/Mohana bench, LiveLaw/HT/Bar and Bench): ordered NO illegal detention of peaceful protesters, normal metro/rail services, undisturbed internet, free movement; directed removal of the Section 163 prohibitory board outside the Supreme Court; said lawyers, journalists and other professionals must not be impeded. Separately, court said a PRIMA FACIE contempt case was made out over metro closures and issued notice to Union Home Secretary Govind Mohan, the Delhi Police Commissioner and DMRC chairperson D Thara — affidavits/compliance by Oct 13; personal appearance dispensed.

items.title: SC Sunday special-sitting order directions now spelled out — metro and railway
items.summary: SC Sunday special-sitting order directions now spelled out — metro and railway services in Delhi to operate normally, internet connectivity to remain undisturbed, free movement of people restored, and removal of prohibitory notices around the Supreme Court and other court complexes to ensure unhindered access to justice. Refines the logged 'SC Directs Govt To Lift All Restrictions' headline.

items.title: Delhi Police detained CPI MP John Brittas PLUS ~100 OTHERS near Connaught Place
items.summary: Delhi Police detained CPI(M) MP John Brittas PLUS ~100 OTHERS near Connaught Place on Sunday — SFI, AISA and Krantikari Yuva Sangathan (KYS) workers packed into buses and removed from the site — 'despite the Supreme Court order.' Adds KYS to the day-2 detention list and puts the first count (~100) on the CP detentions; frames them as continuing after the SC's lift-restrictions order. Single-sourced; watch for corroboration.

items.title: Refinement : CPI MP John Brittas was TAKEN INTO CUSTODY following the argument
items.summary: Refinement (never explicitly logged; blog intro summary now updated): CPI(M) MP John Brittas was TAKEN INTO CUSTODY following the argument with Delhi Police at Connaught Place — earlier log had it as 'cops tried to detain, altercation.' Same summary confirms AISA, SFI and other left-wing org workers + CJP workers detained from CP's inner circle on Sunday.

items.title: First reported development from the Supreme Court's Sunday special sitting
items.summary: first reported development from the Supreme Court's Sunday special sitting — the Bench (Bagchi/Mohana) said it will 'hear all sides, ensure no public trouble' on the Delhi protest curbs matter. No order yet; contempt plea + preventive-detention challenge both on the board.

items.title: CJP's first official reaction to the morning release: the party's X account
items.summary: CJP's first official reaction to the morning release: the party's X account posted 'FINALLY DELHI POLICE IS FORCED TO RELEASE ABHIJEET DIPKE, ASHUTOSH RANKA AND SAURAV DAS. Cockroaches never die.' (TOI via newspointapp, agency inputs). No new facts beyond the statement itself; notes Dipke's family preparing grandmother's last rites Sunday and Delhi Police's earlier offer of humanitarian travel.

items.title: Delhi Police registered OVER 20 FIRs in connection with attempts to forcibly
items.summary: Delhi Police registered OVER 20 FIRs in connection with attempts to forcibly stage protests in the national capital (IANS via hiindia.com, Oct 11, Sunday). Offences cited: taking the law into one's own hands, obstructing official duties, and assaulting police personnel, as protesters gathered around Jantar Mantar demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over SIR issues. First concrete criminal-case count of the crackdown — advances Saturday's 'likely FIR over assault on police' note.

items.title: MEA statement + Rathee release condition
items.summary: MEA statement + Rathee release condition (Reuters, 'Indian capital braces for second day of protests', updated <1h before this run): India's foreign ministry said Sunday the UN Human Rights office's approach was 'selective' and its statement on the mass detentions was 'an unwarranted interference in the internal affairs of India' — first QUOTED official MEA wording (earlier live-blog note only said 'misplaced'). Separately, Reuters reports Dhruv Rathee was released past midnight 'on condition he did not participate in any further protests,' per an unnamed interior ministry official (single-sourced; refines the earlier police-warning framing).

items.title: DMRC LIFTED the restriction on entry/exit of all 45 metro stations — 'Entry and
items.summary: DMRC LIFTED the restriction on entry/exit of all 45 metro stations — 'Entry and exit gates of all Metro Stations of the Delhi Metro network are now open. The interchange facility at all the concerned Metro stations is also available' (DMRC X post; thedailyjagran.com live blog). Day-long transport curbs effectively over; comes ahead of Sunday's SC special sitting on the contempt plea over those very curbs.

items.title: SC Sunday special sitting detail: TWO matters before a special Bench of
items.summary: SC Sunday special sitting detail: TWO matters before a special Bench of Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana — (1) an Article 32 plea by TMC MP & Sr Adv Menaka Guruswamy challenging preventive detention of opposition leaders (Kejriwal, Mamata Banerjee, Pinarayi Vijayan, Manik Sarkar, others), arguing detention can't curtail the right to peaceful protest; (2) a contempt petition by advocate Shailendra Mani Tripathi against Union Home Secretary Govind Mohan, Delhi Police Commissioner Anurag Kumar and others over alleged disobedience of the Oct 9 directions on metro/train curbs (India Legal).

items.title: CJP announced via its X backup handle @Cockroachisback that interim leader
items.summary: CJP announced via its X backup handle @Cockroachisback that interim leader Ajinkya Shinde will lead a MARCH TO JANTAR MANTAR AGAIN ON SUNDAY (Oct 11) until demands are met — 'we will not back down' — continuing the CEC Gyanesh Kumar resignation demand after Saturday's crackdown. Reported by verified RVCJ Media (13M followers) IG post; also aligns with the INDIA bloc's planned mega protest Monday. Dipke, Das, Ranka still detained; no word on release or last-rites travel.

items.title: CJP 24-hour ultimatum on a protest date (verified RVCJ Media IG carousel
items.summary: CJP 24-hour ultimatum on a protest date (verified RVCJ Media IG carousel, posted 12:23 AM IST Oct 12, reporting official X backup @Cockroachisback post; quote corroborated by thedailyjagran day-2 live blog 10:52 PM IST entry): 'Delhi Police can give us date for Jantar Mantar protest in 24 hours, else CJP will give another protest call.' Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das (@SauravDassss) and Ratna Singh (@whattalawyer) will visit PARLIAMENT STREET POLICE STATION at 10 AM Monday Oct 12 to DEMAND a date for their peaceful Jantar Mantar protest; police has 24 hours to respond before CJP issues its own protest call.

items.title: Congress posted a video on X saying the party will meet the Chief Justice of
items.summary: Congress posted a video on X saying the party will meet the Chief Justice of India on Monday to brief him on the situation, accusing the PM and HM of an 'undeclared Emergency' (~12:04 PM IST). Links to the INDIA bloc Monday mega-protest watch.

items.title: INDIA bloc planning a major protest on Monday amid the crackdown
items.summary: INDIA bloc planning a major protest on Monday amid the crackdown (sources; 07:25 PM IST, thedailyjagran.com live blog). TMC chief Mamata Banerjee cancelled her scheduled return to Kolkata and extended her stay in Delhi to join it — she had been detained Saturday afternoon after a sit-in near the South Avenue bus stand.

items.title: Rahul Gandhi: opposition parties, civil society and youth will MARCH TO THE
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi: opposition parties, civil society and youth will MARCH TO THE SUPREME COURT ON MONDAY to submit a memorandum to the CJI demanding an end to 'vote chori', CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation and halting of SIR (day-2 blog, 08:29 PM IST). First march specifics for the logged Congress 'meet CJI Monday' plan; links to the INDIA bloc Monday mega-protest.

items.title: CJI Surya Kant REJECTED the INDIA bloc leaders' request for a meeting to submit
items.summary: CJI Surya Kant REJECTED the INDIA bloc leaders' request for a meeting to submit a representation. A reasoned email says the matters are sub judice and he cannot entertain political meetings on the administrative side; Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge were advised to file petitions on the judicial side instead (PTI/ANI via Jagran; corroborated by Latestly, LiveMint, devdiscourse, webindia123). Rahul and Kharge had sought 4–5 PM Monday to hand over a memorandum (end 'vote chori', CEC resignation, halt SIR, return to paper ballots).

items.title: Delhi Police released a VIDEO of informing Dipke about his grandmother's death
items.summary: Delhi Police released a VIDEO of informing Dipke about his grandmother's death in custody (The Daily Jagran IG reel @thedailyjagran, posted 03:56:57Z / 9:26 AM IST Mon): split-screen office-room footage of a female police officer informing a man in a white t-shirt (identified on-screen as Dipke) about the death; he lowers his head into his hands and is offered water. First visual evidence in the disputed informing story — police claiming 'due sensitivity', parents claiming 'Delhi Police is lying', Dipke himself saying he was denied a phone.

items.title: Leaders PRODUCED before the Executive Magistrate at Delhi Cantt Police Station
items.summary: Leaders PRODUCED before the Executive Magistrate at Delhi Cantt Police Station (~9:36 AM IST); court proceedings to begin shortly. First formal production after ~23 hours in custody. Ratna Singh present with other advocates as counsel.

items.title: FIRST post-release statement from CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke — 'Modi, as PM, is
items.summary: FIRST post-release statement from CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke — 'Modi, as PM, is an embarrassment to India.' First public words from Dipke since the ~10:10 AM IST Executive Magistrate release. (Also: Dipke's grandmother's last rites were due 10 AM IST; family had put them on hold — still no confirmed word on whether Dipke travelled.)

items.title: Release-terms refinement
items.summary: Release-terms refinement (no new event; consolidates the already-reported ~10:10 AM IST release): the Executive Magistrate released Dipke, Das and Ranka via the Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) Court at Delhi Cantt after a Rs 50,000 SURETY BOND was furnished, with a one-year maintain-peace-and-good-behaviour condition (Delhi Police statement via thedailyjagran.com; CJP legal head Ratna Singh corroborated on X). Same one-year condition already logged via journalist Kumkum Binwal's channel; surety amount is new detail only.

items.title: RELEASE ORDER: an Executive Magistrate court at Delhi Cantt PS ordered the
items.summary: RELEASE ORDER: an Executive Magistrate court at Delhi Cantt PS ordered the RELEASE of CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka after nearly 24 hours of preventive detention (order ~10:10 AM IST, per Latestly published 10:14 AM IST; announced by CJP legal head Ratna Singh on X @whattalawyer, corroborated by LiveLaw @LiveLawIndia, Bar & Bench, Indian Express, TV9 Bharatvarsh, Zee News, TOI, Sakal, Saam TV, News18, Navbharat Times). Sakal (Marathi) reports the release was on BAIL granted by the magistrate; News18 graphic claims a condition barring the three from going to Jantar Mantar (single-sourced, awaiting corroboration); Apurva Asrani flags unknown release terms and notes Dhruv Rathee hasn't been seen since his 3 AM release.

items.title: Arvind Kejriwal claimed on X that Haryana Police arrested Atul Agarwal
items.summary: Arvind Kejriwal claimed on X that Haryana Police arrested Atul Agarwal, editor-in-chief of Hindi Khabar and the Living India group, linking it to the channel's drug-trafficking coverage in Haryana (~10:28 AM IST). Police unconfirmed; not independently verified.

items.title: Sidebar : official party celebration of the ~10:10 AM IST magistrate release
items.summary: Sidebar (pre-baseline 10:35 AM IST, never logged; IG post @cockroachjantaparty 'WE ARE BACK' graphic, ~254K likes): official party celebration of the ~10:10 AM IST magistrate release — no new facts beyond the already-alerted release; noted for completeness only.

items.title: Delhi Police X statement
items.summary: Delhi Police X statement (refines logged Hindu Raksha Dal arrests): took suo motu cognizance of a video showing four men assaulting a protester, began legal proceedings through Kamla Market PS, and says all four have been identified and traced (~11:34 AM IST; never logged explicitly).

items.title: FIRST post-release statement from CJP co-convener Ashutosh Ranka
items.summary: FIRST post-release statement from CJP co-convener Ashutosh Ranka (12:44 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog quoting his X post): 'Gyanesh Kumar is a traitor. I am even willing to spend my entire life in jail to get such traitors removed.' First public words from Ranka since the ~10:10 AM IST Executive Magistrate release (joins Dipke's post-release 'embarrassment' quote and the three leaders' News Minute interview).

items.title: TWO new official-handle reels from the post-release 2 PM IST Press Club presser
items.summary: (catch-up, never logged by earlier runs — CLI parse error at earlier legs mis-sorted posts by rank): TWO new official-handle reels from the post-release 2 PM IST Press Club presser window — (1) @cockroachjantaparty reel 02:30:17 PDT (= 09:30:17Z / 3:00 PM IST, ~355K likes): 'PC After detention! Still finding answers!' (#cjp #peace #press #delhi #election) — first press-conference video posted on the party's own handle, posted ~45 min after the presser began; (2) @cockroachjantaparty reel 02:14:09 PDT (= 09:14:09Z / 2:44 PM IST, ~82K likes): 'हम निहत्थे लोग, तुम्हें हरा कर रहेगी!' ('We, the unarmed people, will defeat you!').

items.title: Presser details : Saurav Das termed the police action 'kidnapping' rather than
items.summary: presser details (topindiannews ANI; the 2 PM IST Press Club of India presser by Das/Ranka): Saurav Das termed the police action 'kidnapping' rather than arrest, raised questions on the National Human Rights Commission's silence, and claimed confiscated phones may have been hacked (article flags all unverified); Ashutosh Ranka alleged policemen stayed present with cameras and mics even after being informed of Dipke's grandmother's demise. CJP described the release as 'a major legal victory' and accused the BJP of 'going beyond the Emergency.' First NHRC mention of the day.

items.title: 2 PM IST press conference content surfaces
items.summary: 2 PM IST press conference content surfaces (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 02:51 PM IST / 09:21Z entry, landed at the last run's baseline, never logged): co-convener Saurav Das alleged the detention was ILLEGAL — 'they were detained without any formal notice and their phones were seized' and they were denied access to lawyers during detention; said the police action 'is all being done to protect one person,' and asked why PM Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah are protecting CEC Gyanesh Kumar. First substantive statements out of the long-awaited Press Club of India presser (began ~2:05 PM IST).

items.title: 2 PM IST press conference BEGINNING
items.summary: 2 PM IST press conference BEGINNING (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 02:05 PM IST / 08:35Z entry): 'After their release from the preventive arrest, the CJP leadership is set to address the media at a press conference shortly. Abhijit Dipke will address the media.' This CONFLICTS with the earlier logged IANS note (hiindia.com, ~2:00 PM IST) that Dipke would NOT attend — he was heading to Maharashtra for his grandmother's last rites, with Das and Ranka addressing instead. Either plans changed or the blog's 'Dipke will address' line is inaccurate — watch the presser content for who actually speaks.

items.title: FIRST post-release sit-down interview with the three freed CJP leaders
items.summary: FIRST post-release sit-down interview with the three freed CJP leaders — founder Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka (patio setting, full video on The News Minute YouTube). They compare the policing of Jantar Mantar to the India-Pakistan border, say the 'biggest achievement of Jantar Mantar 1.0' was that people no longer fear the regime, and Dipke directly appeals to BJP supporters to join the protest, warning their votes could be deleted if 'Modi is displeased'; new slogan teased — 'Gyanu it's done bro'. First substantive post-release remarks from all three beyond Dipke's one-line quote and the 2 PM IST presser (still pending ~1h15m out).

items.title: 2 PM IST press conference detail
items.summary: 2 PM IST press conference detail (India Today / The Lallantop YouTube video, crawled <1h before run; IANS via hiindia.com, ~2:00 PM IST): venue confirmed as the Press Club of India, New Delhi. Crucially, Dipke himself will NOT attend — he is heading to his hometown in Maharashtra for his grandmother's last rites; co-conveners Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka will address the press instead. New Dipke quote: 'October 10 will go down as the beginning of the end of this dictatorship.' Advances the previously logged '2 PM press conference pending' — Dipke's absence is new.

items.title: Ex-Attorney General KK Venugopal told the Supreme Court his former junior
items.summary: ex-Attorney General KK Venugopal told the Supreme Court his former junior colleague was 'arbitrarily lifted by the Delhi Police and dumped 11 kilometres away without any explanation' by personnel without badges (~02:03 PM IST).

items.title: Police statement : Delhi Police DCP Sachin Sharma told ANI 'The situation is
items.summary: police statement (02:05 PM IST / 08:35Z; thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog): Delhi Police DCP Sachin Sharma told ANI 'The situation is under control; we are trying to maintain peace and tranquility.' First on-record senior-officer situation assessment of day 2, landing as the press conference begins.

items.title: FIRST personal post-release Instagram post from CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke
items.summary: (catch-up; landed in the 08:19–08:31Z gap when IG-CLI legs were skipped, never logged): FIRST personal post-release Instagram post from CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke — @abhijeetdipke image post at 2:07 PM IST (~08:37:41Z) captioned 'I'm sorry.' with a black-and-white photo of his late grandmother (rural churning-milk portrait) — a tribute/apology for missing her last rites; ~146K likes, 5.5K comments, condolence-heavy replies. Lands as the 2 PM IST Press Club presser (being addressed by Das and Ranka instead, per Dipke's own X post) was beginning — confirms his absence is the last-rites trip.

items.title: Presser footage : speaker at the Press Club of India press conference recounts
items.summary: Presser footage (News24 @news24official IG reel, posted 2:43 PM IST / 09:13:21Z, 5.4M-follower verified account): speaker at the Press Club of India press conference recounts the detention ordeal — on-screen quotes 'we were kidnapped from the plane,' 'the government is scared,' 'these people have made the country hostage,' 'I had heard of Emergency, today I saw it too'; the speaker describes being told of his grandmother's death while police remained stationed outside his house and being barred from contacting his elderly heart-patient parents.

items.title: Post-presser rallying call from co-convener Saurav Das
items.summary: Post-presser rallying call from co-convener Saurav Das (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 02:57 PM IST / 09:27Z entry, surfaced after the 09:50Z check): Das said CJP 'will not be intimidated and will not return' until CEC Gyanesh Kumar resigns, and explicitly asked people to 'hit the streets in protest.' Follow-on from the same 2 PM IST Press Club presser already logged for his 'illegal detention' claims — first on-record post-release street-protest call from Das (Dipke is heading to Maharashtra for last rites, so Das/Ranka are now the public voice).

items.title: Delhi Police formally informed Dipke in custody of his grandmother's demise
items.summary: Delhi Police formally informed Dipke in custody of his grandmother's demise (03:01 PM IST); former Delhi CM / AAP convenor Arvind Kejriwal detained by Delhi Police with Saurabh Bhardwaj and Sanjay Singh (~03:05 PM IST) — Kejriwal later posted a 'We have been detained' video (03:45 PM IST); former West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee and TMC MPs detained (02:30 PM IST, per ANI); FIRST injury/violence report of the day — two police officials allegedly injured in stone-pelting near the PTI building (01:17 PM IST, per India Today via Jagran live blog), contradicting the earlier 'no injuries' picture; AISA President Neha Bora + Yogendra Yadav protest near INA; SFI workers toppled police barricades at Imtiaz Khan Marg.

items.title: Presser video : footage of the Press Club of India press conference — a CJP
items.summary: presser video (The Caravan Magazine IG, posted 09:33:07Z / 3:03 PM IST, landed in-window, never logged): footage of the Press Club of India press conference — a CJP leader (young man, curly hair, glasses, blue t-shirt; identity unconfirmed) details the detention in Hindi: taken without papers, phones seized, denied access to lawyers, refused documentation, moved between locations including PRIVATE VEHICLES — and alleges phones may have been HACKED OR CLONED. Claims 'violates fundamental rights'. Adds 'private vehicles' and 'phone hacking/cloning' allegations beyond Saurav Das's logged 'no notice / phones seized / lawyer access denied' claims.

items.title: CJP disputes the release-bond interpretation
items.summary: CJP disputes the release-bond interpretation (thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog, 03:45 PM IST / 10:15Z): in an X post, CJP said 'No CJP leader has signed any bond that says they will not protest any more. The bond refers to refraining of breach of peace. But participating in a peaceful protest is a Constitutional right and DOES NOT breach peace.' First official post-release pushback on the SEM one-year peace/good-behaviour condition (Rs 50,000 surety) — signals the party intends to keep protesting despite the bond; sets up the next confrontation point.

items.title: Indian Youth Congress launched a legal helpline for detained protesters amid
items.summary: Indian Youth Congress launched a legal helpline (9582223884) for detained protesters amid the CJP agitation — receiving complaints of intimidation/harassment linked to the demonstrations and facilitating legal assistance (03:55 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: CJP's interim protest leader Ajinkya Shinde urged people to march towards
items.summary: CJP's interim protest leader Ajinkya Shinde urged people to march towards Jantar Mantar to join the demonstration, in an X post: 'If Delhi Police tries to stop you, wherever they stop you will become your Jantar Mantar' (04:06 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: FIRST action reporting from Mumbai's 4 PM Shivaji Park protest — verified
items.summary: (catch-up, never logged by earlier runs; posted 10:44:23Z = 4:14 PM IST, ~6 min before baseline): FIRST action reporting from Mumbai's 4 PM Shivaji Park protest — verified SaamTV News (@saamtvnews, 3.1M followers) 'BIG BREAKING' Marathi reel (IG): large Mumbai police contingent surrounding and detaining several protesters near Shivaji Park, leading them to a police bus; a female protester on camera alleges female police forcibly took her phone. Ticker references CJP press conference, PM Modi, Ashutosh Rane remarks. Fills the 'NO outcome/turnout reporting' gap on the 4 PM IST Mumbai call flagged by the 10:24Z/10:26Z/10:30Z runs.

items.title: CJP posted a video on X alleging Delhi Police beat its leaders who were
items.summary: CJP posted a video on X (credited to Apoorv Kumar) alleging Delhi Police beat its leaders who were protesting peacefully (~04:16 PM IST). Police have not responded (Claim). New video-form accusation; substance overlaps Ranka's presser assault allegation.

items.title: PIB Fact Check flagged a crowd video shared as the Delhi protest as OLD footage
items.summary: PIB Fact Check flagged a crowd video shared as the Delhi protest as OLD footage from Assam, October 2025 (~04:21 PM IST); separately pinned a warning about old incidents, unrelated visuals and AI-generated videos being shared as the current protest, urging source-checking before sharing (govt comms).

items.title: Counter-litigation — a lawyers' body moved the Supreme Court asking it to stop
items.summary: counter-litigation — a lawyers' body moved the Supreme Court asking it to stop the successive CJP demonstrations, arguing they are aimed at media attention and are 'paralysing' Delhi / disrupting lawyers' livelihoods (LiveLaw, ~04:22 PM IST). First plea AGAINST the protest itself.

items.title: Delhi Police served a FRESH NOTICE to CJP leaders after their release from
items.summary: Delhi Police served a FRESH NOTICE to CJP leaders after their release from detention, following the Press Club of India press briefing (NDTV video, ~04:33 PM IST). Details of the notice unclear — initial reports suggest legal or social media-related compliance issues (single-sourced NDTV).

items.title: First statement of day 2 from Congress National President Mallikarjun Kharge
items.summary: first statement of day 2 from Congress National President Mallikarjun Kharge (ANI, 04:36 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com day-2 live blog entry, landed after the prior run's 11:41:30Z baseline): 'PM Modi and Shah have made up their minds to remove democracy.' Kharge tied it to the vote-chori framing — claimed two CEC members 'exposed how mismanaged the system is' and wrote to Gyanesh Kumar without response, and said the INDIA alliance is now united behind Rahul Gandhi's agitation. First Congress president-level statement of the protest.

items.title: Interim leader Ajinkya Shinde posted a video on X from what he called the
items.summary: Interim leader Ajinkya Shinde posted a video on X from what he called the Surajmal detention centre (~04:47 PM IST), saying in Hindi they will not leave until all demands are met. Police have NOT confirmed his detention (single-sourced Claim). If confirmed, this changes Shinde's status from active to detained.

items.title: First detailed substance of Delhi Police's 05:34 PM IST media briefing
items.summary: first detailed substance of Delhi Police's 05:34 PM IST media briefing (News18 India IG clip, 13:29:18Z): officer says protest organisers gave written undertakings to follow lawful directions but did not comply; no permission was granted for a Jantar Mantar demo; FIRs registered under BNS sections incl. 163 and 173 against named individuals such as Dipke and his associates plus Congress party workers for unlawful assembly; mentions violence, fire and damage to public property. Parallel News24 Digital carousel (13:06:07Z) quotes DCP PRO Neha Yadav in Hindi on why Jantar Mantar permission was denied (prior protest non-compliance, stone-pelting, arson, violence; inset photo of bloodstained-shirt injured man).

items.title: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi publicly backed the detained Delhi protesters in
items.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi publicly backed the detained Delhi protesters in an X post, accusing PM Modi and the RSS of attacking the Constitution and urging youth to 'keep protesting' — 'We are going to defend our Constitution... Youth of India, I am proud of you. Keep protesting.' (05:45 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: Actor Imran Khan detained by Mumbai Police at August Kranti Maidan , among ~400
items.summary: Actor Imran Khan detained by Mumbai Police at August Kranti Maidan (proposed protest venue in support of CJP's call), among ~400 detained in Mumbai (05:58 PM IST; ANI via thedailyjagran.com live blog). Live blog headline tally now reads '3 Ex-CMs, Actor Imran Khan and Dipke among 3000 detainees.'

items.title: Institutional pushback on CJP's core claim — 124 former IAS, IFS and
items.summary: Institutional pushback on CJP's core claim — 124 former IAS, IFS and allied-services officers signed an open letter backing the Election Commission and its SIR of electoral rolls, questioning vote-rigging claims as lacking credible evidence (06:04 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: — Dipke via X : 'Haven't signed any bond that says we won't protest
items.summary: (catch-up, in-window) — Dipke via X (day-2 blog, 06:22 PM IST): 'Haven't signed any bond that says we won't protest. We will hit the streets again.' His own voice on the logged SEM bond dispute (Rs 50,000 surety, 1-yr peace condition); CJP X had made the same constitutional point earlier.

items.title: FOUR former CMs now confirmed detained by Delhi Police: Kejriwal, Mamata
items.summary: FOUR former CMs now confirmed detained by Delhi Police: Kejriwal, Mamata Banerjee, Pinarayi Vijayan and Manik Sarkar (06:36 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog) — adds Tripura ex-CM Manik Sarkar to the previously logged 3 ex-CMs.

items.title: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta accused Rahul Gandhi and Arvind Kejriwal of trying to turn
items.summary: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta (BJP) accused Rahul Gandhi and Arvind Kejriwal of trying to turn the capital into a "battleground" with CJP as their "B-Team"; asserted Delhi would not be held hostage amid the protests (06:39 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog). First direct statement from the Delhi CM on the protest.

items.title: Dipke personally rebuts Delhi Police
items.summary: Dipke personally rebuts Delhi Police (IG post @abhijeetdipke 06:16:30 PDT / 13:16:30Z / 6:46 PM IST, ~254K likes; also posted on X): says police denied him his phone 'even for a couple of minutes' to get his cousin's number, denied his request to call a lawyer, and at 3:30 AM made him call his father to say he would 'go to jail for a long time' — the same father who had just lost his mother. Directly counters the logged Delhi Police X claim that he was informed 'with due sensitivity' and denied humanitarian travel (day-2 blog 07:36 PM IST entry; verified via instagram-cli + media-understanding).

items.title: Mumbai Police detained Shiv Sena MLA Varun Sardesai and Kasturi Gandhi
items.summary: Mumbai Police detained Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Varun Sardesai and Kasturi Gandhi, daughter of Tushar Gandhi (06:59 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog). Earlier in the evening Tushar Gandhi himself was detained in Mumbai. Cracks down now hitting Sena (UBT) leaders and Gandhi-family members in Mumbai.

items.title: Official directive : 'This is just the beginning!' — reposts the party X
items.summary: official directive (06:49:46 PDT / 7:19 PM IST; @cockroachjantaparty image post, ~140K likes): 'This is just the beginning!' — reposts the party X statement telling all Delhi supporters to 'stay back' because the 'next call' is on its way, and noting 'for Cockroaches outside Delhi, the trains are running again'. First post-release mobilization directive from the official handle (verified via instagram-cli). Two official stories also posted 06:27/06:32 PDT (one captioned 'Icon!

items.title: AISA president Neha Bora released / got her phone back after police detention
items.summary: AISA president Neha Bora released / got her phone back after police detention: 'My phone had been taken away by the police. Women have also been released from Maidan Garhi PS.' (07:39 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog, quoting her X post @neha_aisa).

items.title: Over 7,000 protesters detained in Delhi , up from the ~3,000 headline tally
items.summary: Over 7,000 protesters detained in Delhi (PTI citing officials), up from the ~3,000 headline tally; police also likely to register an FIR over the alleged assault on police personnel during the demonstration (07:43 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: Yashaswinee Raje Singh — daughter of former UP BJP MLA Vikram Singh — detained
items.summary: Yashaswinee Raje Singh — daughter of former UP BJP MLA Vikram Singh — detained in Delhi 'near Bangla Sahib for sitting in a park'; being held at Keshav Puram police station (08:07 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog, quoting her X post).

items.title: Mumbai front escalates: Aaditya Thackeray and MNS leader Amit Thackeray staged
items.summary: Mumbai front escalates: Aaditya Thackeray (Shiv Sena UBT) and MNS leader Amit Thackeray staged a protest OUTSIDE SHIVAJI PARK POLICE STATION against the detention of protesters (day-2 blog, 08:14 PM IST). Follows the logged 4 PM Shivaji Park detentions incl. Anjali Damania and the Mumbai FIR against Imran Khan.

items.title: UN Human Rights office expressed concern over 'mass detention' of
items.summary: UN Human Rights office expressed concern over 'mass detention' of demonstrators, protest leaders, civil society members, lawyers and journalists before and during the Delhi demonstrations; called on authorities to ensure the right to peaceful assembly is respected (08:20 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog, quoting @UNHumanRights).

items.title: 'He Could Have Come', says Dipke's father
items.summary: 'He Could Have Come', says Dipke's father (Bhagwan Dipke to ANI, 08:39 PM IST / 15:09Z entry, thedailyjagran day-2 blog): if Delhi Police had released Dipke on time — or on condition he return after the funeral — he could have seen his grandmother; 'I just saw on Instagram that he had reached Nagpur... The police made a mistake; they shouldn't have mentioned things that weren't meant to be disclosed... they should have given him some time — time for the final viewing of his grandmother.' New statement; 'reached Nagpur' corroborates the single-sourced Hingoli arrival and moves Dipke's homeward journey past Nagpur.

items.title: Arvind Kejriwal RELEASED after over five hours in detention — he had been
items.summary: Arvind Kejriwal RELEASED after over five hours in detention — he had been detained in central Delhi in the afternoon and taken to Jafarpur police station (08:54 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog).

items.title: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta second statement of the day
items.summary: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta second statement of the day (10:04 PM IST; thedailyjagran.com live blog): called the protest situation 'extremely unfortunate,' accused Congress, AAP, Left and CJP protesters of creating a confrontational atmosphere under the guise of agitation, thanked Delhi residents for patience, and praised Delhi Police/security personnel for handling it professionally and prioritizing public safety; said the law would take its course firmly. First follow-up CM statement after the 7,000+ detention tally; earlier (06:39 PM IST) she had called CJP Congress/AAP's 'B-Team'.

items.title: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Sudhanshu Trivedi at a BJP headquarters presser attacked
items.summary: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Sudhanshu Trivedi at a BJP headquarters presser attacked CJP's 'sudden' shift from the NEET paper-leak/student agitation to electoral politics: 'Perhaps you wouldn't see such a fast mutation even in radioactive decay.' New BJP party-line attack of the day.

items.title: Delhi Police BEGAN a media briefing on the protest situation and the alleged
items.summary: Delhi Police BEGAN a media briefing on the protest situation and the alleged attacks on cops during the CJP protest. First police press briefing of the day beyond DCP Sachin Sharma's one-line 'situation under control' comment to ANI; briefing content not yet detailed on the blog.

items.title: FIRST confirmation Dipke reached home for last rites
items.summary: FIRST confirmation Dipke reached home for last rites (topindiannews ANI article, single-sourced): after release, Abhijeet Dipke left for his village in Hingoli, Maharashtra and 'reached the village for his last darshan' before his grandmother's last rites. Resolves the open 'last-rites arrival unconfirmed' watch question (family had put rites on hold; police's humanitarian-travel offer was disputed by parents). Single-sourced — watch for corroboration.

items.title: Founder Abhijeet Dipke's post-release remarks to reporters — 'I am going home
items.summary: founder Abhijeet Dipke's post-release remarks to reporters — 'I am going home now to be with my family, as my grandmother has passed away. Ashutosh and Saurav will hold a press conference at 2 pm and announce the future course of action... What is it about Gyanesh Kumar that you inconvenienced millions of people yesterday to protect?' New quotes: the 'inconvenienced millions' line is first-seen here; confirms Das/Ranka presser plan (matches logged IANS 'Dipke skipping presser' line).

items.title: Sidebar : claims the SEM release order included a 'no public gatherings or
items.summary: Sidebar (single-sourced, low-cred dainiknewslive.in): claims the SEM release order included a 'no public gatherings or instigate unrest' condition. Uncorroborated; similar to the earlier News18 'barred from Jantar Mantar' claim, which also remains single-sourced.

items.title: Sidebar : police sources claim the released trio left Delhi Cantt PS
items.summary: Sidebar (single-sourced, low-cred outlet dainiknewslive.in, ~1h crawl): police sources claim the released trio left Delhi Cantt PS 'completely alone' — no supporters at the gates — after ANI quoted Ranka announcing the 2 PM press conference. Colour on the release scene, not a development per se.

items.title: FIRST post-release statement from YouTuber Dhruv Rathee — 'I was not arrested
items.summary: FIRST post-release statement from YouTuber Dhruv Rathee — 'I was not arrested or detained, I was Abducted! here's the [full story]' — directly disputes the 'preventive detention' framing. Confirms he is back online (resolves the earlier 'not seen since his 3 AM release' gap).

items.title: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke's father Bhagwan Dipke publicly slammed the police
items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke's father Bhagwan Dipke publicly slammed the police action after his son's airport detention: 'I don't understand why so much police force is deployed in Delhi? Have dacoits from Chambal gathered in Delhi? Dacoits are sitting in Parliament.' First public statement from Dipke's immediate family against the crackdown.

items.title: Dozens of CJP protesters/students took shelter at Gurdwara Bangla Sahib after
items.summary: Dozens of CJP protesters/students took shelter at Gurdwara Bangla Sahib after being chased from central Delhi; Delhi Police entered the shrine premises and detained 60+ supporters and student activists incl. SFI's Aishe Ghosh (per DNA India video; ~1 PM police move). AISA's Neha Bora slammed police for entering the gurdwara; Saurabh Bhardwaj also posted video criticizing officers entering with shoes on and heads uncovered.

items.title: BJP national spokesperson/MP Sambit Patra's press conference called the CJP
items.summary: BJP national spokesperson/MP Sambit Patra's press conference called the CJP Jantar Mantar protest a 'flop show' — claimed attempts to hold Delhi/India hostage failed and 'loktantra' triumphed over 'bheedtantra' ('democracy triumphed over mob rule; the anarchists have failed'); hit out at Rahul Gandhi. First official BJP party-line statement of the day (PTI video, thedailyjagran.com, Mirror Now).

items.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, speaking at the Dainik Jagran Sahitya Srijan
items.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, speaking at the Dainik Jagran Sahitya Srijan Samman ceremony, asserted 'no one has the right to spread anarchy in the country,' saying Gen-Z youth may be 'temporarily misled by Western interests' but would never be diverted from nation-building (thedailyjagran.com live blog). First cabinet-minister-level public statement of the day on the protest.

items.title: CJP official statement on Instagram
items.summary: CJP official statement on Instagram (@cockroachjantaparty, posted 04:55 UTC, missed by earlier runs): appeal to Delhi Police to IMMEDIATELY release founder Abhijeet Dipke from 'illegal detention' — his grandmother has passed away, the family cannot even inform him, his whereabouts remain unknown and even his lawyers cannot reach him ('At the very least, let him speak to his family. Same sweep surfaced a 04:47 UTC post denouncing 'Amit Shah's police' (commentary, no new facts — not reportable).

items.title: CJP named successor: Organization In-Charge Ajinkya Shinde to lead the Jantar
items.summary: CJP named successor: Organization In-Charge Ajinkya Shinde to lead the Jantar Mantar protest while Dipke, Das, Ranka are detained (pre-recorded handover reel; @cockroachjantaparty 08:12 UTC, echoed by @cjp_vicepresident 09:00 UTC). No violence/injuries reported so far.

items.title: Detention-location refinement for the detained leaders — Dipke reportedly taken
items.summary: detention-location refinement for the detained leaders — Dipke reportedly taken to Gurugram, Saurav Das to a detention centre in Jafarpur Kalan, Ashutosh Ranka to one in Outer Delhi ('reportedly'; single-sourced).

items.title: CJP National Spokesperson / North Zone In-charge Deepak Baliyan claims he has
items.summary: CJP National Spokesperson / North Zone In-charge Deepak Baliyan (@choudhary_deepak_baliyan) claims he has been under HOUSE ARREST at his home for 4 days, with 40+ plainclothes police stationed and a nakabandi (blockade) across his area — self-reported on his own Instagram reel; not independently corroborated. First named CJP office-bearer alleging a multi-day house arrest outside Delhi.

items.event_time_ist: Monday, Oct 12 ~10:00 AM IST (visit); first outcome footage/reporting ~12:21 PM IST
items.source_name: Aaj Tak (verified IG @aajtak, 19M followers) + ANI via apnamatvchannel.com
items.summary: Ranka, Das and Ratna Singh visited Parliament Street Police Station ~10 AM IST Monday demanding a Jantar Mantar protest date under CJP's 24-hour ultimatum. Surrounded by police and media, Saurabh Das flipped the 10-day permission rule back: 'Police tells everyone to approach them 10 days in advance. We are now saying that they have the choice to tell us the date and time (for protest at Jantar Mantar). We are giving them 24-hour ultimatum.' Ranka: 'We are going to ask Delhi Police for a date... We hope the police will give us a date. If they do not, we will make another call within 24 hours.' No police decision reported yet; the 24-hour clock is running. (First outcome reporting of the planned 10 AM visit; on-screen Aaj Tak Hindi text: 'CJP की दिल्ली पुलिस से मांग, सौरभ दास ने कहा- प्रदर्शन की तारीख बता दीजिए..')
items.title: PS-visit outcome: Das flips the 10-day rule back on police — 'you tell us the date and time'

items.summary: LoP Rahul Gandhi raised the pitch for Monday's 'Chalo Dilli' march from Connaught Place to the Supreme Court against the Election Commission — even though CJI Surya Kant declined the Congress meeting request. Gandhi also called for a news conference on the protest; X post: 'March for Democracy. March for Justice. Chalo Dilli.' (The march-to-SC plan was already logged; the press-conference call and 'Chalo Dilli' framing are new.)
items.title: Rahul Gandhi calls 'Chalo Dilli' presser + afternoon CP→SC march
Rahul Gandhi presser ahead of march: offers CEC to resign and turn approver; says opposition will file SC petition today
items.summary: Speaking at a press conference before the 1:30 PM IST Chalo Dilli march, Rahul Gandhi offered CEC Gyanesh Kumar the chance to resign and turn approver — asking him to admit he erred but is 'not the mind behind the mistake.' He said the CJI declined a meeting but asked the opposition to file a petition, which INDIA bloc leaders will file at the Supreme Court today. Gandhi claimed 50% of Delhi Police privately back the protests and alleged police are being asked to free 'RSS goons' who beat protesters; said anti-'vote chori' resistance has brewed 12 years and is crystallising now. He urged citizens to join at 1:30 PM at Barakhamba Junction, Connaught Place.
items.source_name: The Daily Jagran (live blog, INDIA bloc march to SC)

items.title: DMRC shuts 6 metro stations 6 AM-4 PM for march; heavy security at Barakhamba/Mandi House
items.summary: DMRC closed entry/exit at six stations — Rajiv Chowk, Janpath, Mandi House, Patel Chowk, Central Secretariat, Barakhamba Road — from 6 AM to 4 PM Monday for the opposition march. Delhi Police barricaded multiple central-Delhi locations; RAF, CRPF and Delhi Police personnel deployed at Barakhamba Road and near Mandi House.
items.source_name: The Daily Jagran (live blog, citing DMRC/Delhi Traffic Police)

items.title: Two new legal fronts: Delhi HC plea against Jantar Mantar closure; SC plea against alleged hooligan attacks
items.summary: A plea challenging the closure of Jantar Mantar for peaceful protests was mentioned before the Delhi High Court; the bench headed by the Acting Chief Justice agreed to list it on Oct 13. Separately, a plea was mentioned before the Supreme Court seeking action against alleged hooligans attacking protesters and lawyers during the ongoing Delhi protests. CJI Surya Kant separately said the court's doors are open to all.
items.source_name: The Daily Jagran (live blog, INDIA bloc march to SC)

items.title: March to start from Barakhamba Road; Akhilesh Yadav confirmed joining, Mamata expected
items.summary: The opposition's march to the Supreme Court will start from Barakhamba Road. Expected participants: Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge, Priyanka Gandhi, Akhilesh Yadav (confirmed joining), Rajeev Rai, Mamata Banerjee, Manoj Jha, KC Venugopal. Congress MP Jebi Mathur framed it as citizens marching 'not as a political party' to protect democracy.
items.source_name: The Daily Jagran (live blog, INDIA bloc march to SC)
